test_description: All cell IDs unique within every exported artifact
pass_criterion: 0 duplicate rownames in raw_df.rds, normalize_df.rds, scale_df.rds, cleaned_dataset$mr_data (unless DEC01/DEC02 duplicate-inclusion decisions explicitly retain flagged duplicates)

test_description: Every source cell has a validated source->study->final mapping
pass_criterion: 100% of source-deposited cells (per approved inclusion policy) appear exactly once in the final study RDS and deployed export, with an explicit crosswalk table committed to the audit trail

test_description: No unexpected cells added or dropped relative to the approved inclusion policy per study
pass_criterion: Final cell count per study exactly equals the count implied by the approved DEC01/DEC02/DEC03/DEC04/DEC09 decisions, with a signed-off manifest

test_description: No metadata vector-length mismatch anywhere in the pipeline
pass_criterion: Every per-cell metadata vector assignment is validated by an explicit assertion (length == ncol(object)) before assignment; build fails loudly otherwise

test_description: Run metadata is always keyed, never positional
pass_criterion: No per-cell metadata field is ever assigned via `rep()`/recycling of a vector shorter than the cell count; all run/library/day/strain assignments trace to an explicit join key

test_description: No literal "NA" string values in any exported field
pass_criterion: grep for the literal string "NA" (not R NA) across all character columns of raw_df.rds, normalize_df.rds, scale_df.rds, cleaned_dataset$mr_data returns zero matches

test_description: Source annotations are preserved in fields distinct from inferred annotations
pass_criterion: Every study/population row in annotation_precedence.tsv has both a non-empty source_* field (or documented "unknown") and a separately named inferred/harmonized field; no field name collision between source and inferred vocabularies

test_description: Non-blood-stage cells receive no blood-IDC/HPI inference
pass_criterion: idc_reference_similarity_label (renamed hour_post_invasion) is NA for 100% of cells whose tissue_or_sample_type is not a validated blood-stage-eligible category

test_description: Source-defined sporozoites are never broad-labeled Blood stage
pass_criterion: parasite_broad_stage == "Sporozoite stage" for 100% of cells whose source_stage_provenance == source_selection_defined with source label Sporozoite (Hazzard2022 runs 498/499, Ruberto2022_2 all cells)

test_description: Liver-stage cells are never exposed as gametocytes
pass_criterion: pred_gametocyte_sex is NA for 100% of cells with parasite_broad_stage == "Liver stage" (Ruberto2022_1 hypnozoites/schizonts)

test_description: Zero/near-zero expression cells receive no expression-derived biological annotation
pass_criterion: pred_gametocyte_sex and idc_reference_similarity_label are both NA for 100% of cells with total UMI count below an explicit, documented minimum threshold

test_description: Hazzard2024 corrected fields match the authoritative table
pass_criterion: 100% agreement between deployed library_id/animal_id/strain/day_post_infection and authoritative_run_table.tsv for all 80,024 cells

test_description: Sa2020 gametocyte source import maps to the correct runs
pass_criterion: Re-running the corrected import (with %in% and the authoritative NIH/PB_MACS crosswalk) reproduces exactly 1532 matched source-sex-annotation rows among cells present in PlaViSca, with 0 false cross-library barcode matches

test_description: Mancio-Silva2022 duplicate policy matches the eventual approved decision
pass_criterion: Cell membership and duplicate-flag fields exactly match the outcome recorded for DEC01/DEC02; no silent deviation

test_description: Ruberto2022_1 repaired counts pass source/reprocessing validation
pass_criterion: Post-repair (per DEC09), the 538 previously near-empty replicate-2 cells either (a) show expression concordant with a documented, reproducible realignment, (b) are explicitly flagged/excluded per the approved policy, or (c) are replaced as part of the complete 1,438-cell matrix by validated author-processed raw UMI counts with an exact cell crosswalk, exact shared-feature equality, and populated count provenance; zero cells remain silently in an unexplained near-empty state

test_description: Raw and normalized expression row/column identity is validated, not assumed
pass_criterion: Every export step asserts exact rowname-set equality between the metadata table and each expression matrix before any cbind/join; build fails loudly on mismatch

test_description: Every exported table uses the same intended cell key
pass_criterion: raw_df.rds, normalize_df.rds, scale_df.rds, and cleaned_dataset$mr_data have identical rowname sets (subject to the approved inclusion policy) and identical row order where a fixed order is asserted

test_description: top_genes_exp (or its renamed successor) contains all studies
pass_criterion: distinct(top_genes_exp$study) has exactly 6 members (or the number implied by the approved inclusion policy), not 1

test_description: App-visible fields have documented semantics
pass_criterion: Every field listed in app_data_contract.tsv has a corresponding, published field definition in metadata_schema.tsv; config/data_columns.yml keys map 1:1 to schema field names with no plural/singular naming mismatch

test_description: No app code relies on obsolete stage vocabulary
pass_criterion: grep across all sourced app R files for hardcoded column names not present in config/data_columns.yml or the current metadata_schema.tsv returns zero matches (fixes the development_phase/parasite_stages dead-code pattern)

test_description: Broad and detailed lifecycle fields are always logically consistent
pass_criterion: For every cell, parasite_broad_stage is a valid mapping-table image of harmonized_life_cycle_stage (no Blood-stage-labeled Sporozoite, no orphaned combinations); mapping table itself is version-controlled

test_description: Source/inferred/harmonized annotation provenance is retained end to end
pass_criterion: Every final annotated cell has a non-empty source_stage_provenance value; deployed export documents which of source_life_cycle_stage / idc_reference_similarity_label / pred_gametocyte_sex / adjudicated_display_stage contributed to harmonized_life_cycle_stage

test_description: Build manifest records input checksums, git commit, package versions, seeds and output checksums
pass_criterion: A single build_manifest.tsv (or equivalent) is produced and committed alongside every regenerated artifact, listing: input file SHA-256 sums, git commit hash of scripts/, R/Seurat/Harmony/SingleR package versions, random seeds used, and output file SHA-256 sums
related_defects: general reproducibility gap (pv_all_studies.rds absent; no manifest ever existed historically)

test_description: Integrated (Harmony) coordinates are validated against unintegrated representation, and RNA-expression integrity is kept explicitly separate from Harmony-space validation
pass_criterion: For each study, a quantitative batch-mixing/kBET- or LISI-style metric is computed and reported comparing pre- and post-Harmony neighbor composition; this validates the Harmony embedding only - raw/normalized RNA expression values (AT16,AT17) are validated independently and the Harmony-space (post-integration reduction) coordinates are never used as a substitute for raw/normalized expression in any differential-expression analysis

test_description: Known lifecycle/tissue biology and marker genes are preserved post-integration
pass_criterion: A fixed panel of stage-specific marker genes (e.g. the female/male gametocyte marker lists already in singleR.R) shows the expected differential expression pattern across the corresponding clusters/cell populations after integration, evaluated quantitatively (not by visual UMAP inspection alone)

test_description: Batch mixing occurs only within biologically comparable populations
pass_criterion: A per-population (e.g. per parasite_broad_stage) neighbor-composition-by-study metric shows appropriate mixing within a shared biological population and appropriately limited mixing across biologically distinct populations (e.g. liver-stage cells should not be neighbor-mixed with sporozoites merely due to Harmony batch correction)

test_description: Study dominance does not erase minority-study signal
pass_criterion: For each non-dominant study (i.e. all except Hazzard2024's ~75.5%), a documented check confirms that population structure specific to that study (e.g. Ruberto2022_1 liver forms) remains separable/identifiable in the integrated space, not merged into the majority signal by construction

test_description: SingleR inference uncertainty is retained
pass_criterion: idc_similarity_raw_label, idc_similarity_score_delta, and idc_similarity_pruned_flag are present and non-null wherever idc_reference_similarity_label is non-NA

test_description: Same-seed reruns are deterministic
pass_criterion: Running the corrected clustering/annotation pipeline twice with identical seed and identical input produces byte-identical numeric cluster assignments per cell; this tests determinism of the code path only and must NOT be read as evidence that the numeric cluster IDs are stable biological identities

test_description: Cluster identity corresponds to marker-defined populations, independent of numeric cluster ID, and is stable under controlled perturbation
pass_criterion: For each biologically expected population (e.g. female/male gametocyte via the existing marker gene lists), an automated marker-score check confirms the same population is recovered regardless of which numeric cluster ID it is assigned; additionally, rerunning with a different seed and/or a perturbed clustering resolution must recover the same marker-defined populations (allowing the numeric IDs themselves to change) - numeric cluster IDs are never treated as biological identities, only marker/population correspondence is

test_description: Every source-defined population and each study's harmonized gametocyte total is present with at least the recorded cell count
pass_criterion: table(study_label, harmonized_life_cycle_stage) contains Female gametocyte and Male gametocyte, and every row of audit/shared_pipeline/stage_population_floors.tsv (Sa2020 source gametocytes, Ruberto2022_1 Hypnozoite/Schizont (Liver stage), Mancio-Silva2022 Hypnozoite/Schizont (Liver stage), Ruberto2022_2 and Hazzard2022 sporozoites, per-study harmonized Female/Male gametocyte totals) has observed >= min_cells; enforced in singleR.R and by audit/phase3_preflight/run_AT31_stage_population_floors.R
